growth.name: Growth
growth.description: Make the company known and find the companies that will buy — Brand schedules and publishes across networks, Prospects finds buyers with cited profiles and runs the deals

proposals.name: Proposals
proposals.description: Write grant and funding proposals from what your sources prove: profile the organisation once, find the funders that fit, turn a call into a checklist, draft every answer with citations, review before you submit

accelerators.name: Accelerators
accelerators.description: Match accelerator Programs to your company and save answers from checked application Forms, with explicit AI drafting and sourced fit results

vantage.name: Vantage
vantage.description: Every week: the decisions that matter, an agenda where every claim cites its source, and follow-through on what was agreed — with a triage view for the program

scenarios.name: Scenarios
scenarios.description: Simulate how people built from your records react to a situation — the feed, who changed their mind and why, and a report. Something to think with, not a forecast

knowledgeGraph.name: Knowledge graph
knowledgeGraph.description: Index health — entities extracted at upload, joined by co-occurrence. Chat answers entity questions from company facts, not from this graph.

repoExplainer.name: Repo explainer
repoExplainer.description: Paste any GitHub repository URL and get a summary plus Mermaid diagram.
